What it is: Give BL-318's quiet-period promotion gate a shell-callable CLI wrapper, so prompt prose is not its sole enforcement
What it solves: WHAT QA FOUND. BL-318 (283b63b) landed `promotion-blocked-by-quiet-period?` and
`format-self-generated-source` in `operator_lib.bb` with ZERO callers — only tests
referenced them. The specifier wired the gate into `coordinator.prompt` (1d4d036) so it
could fire at all, but that wiring is PROSE tell…
How it works: The gate blocks only self-generated work during a quiet period
